scope: Known-model highlight reconstruction and functional macOS qualification, not measured camera colour accuracy or universal superiority.

frozen_implementation_and_generator.correction: Initial purported validation omitted --validation and exactly repeated development: excluded as independent evidence. complete_clipping_counterexample.interpretation: The old neutral assumption is closer on the bright neutral scene and much farther on the near-limit coloured scene with identical RAW input. Neither can determine the original colour and intensity uniquely.

timing.scope: Three D750, three warmups and thirty alternating decodes per engine/file. No concurrent heavy checks. Input hashing/IPC included; output hashing/metrics excluded. No controlled thermal/cold-start/RSS qualification.

checks.python_scope: 29 in the complete suite, including the explicit-generation-mode regression; the five diagnostic tests also passed separately.

development_findings: The initial affine-only policy rejected real intensity steps. Piecewise models alone could shift edges by one CFA site. Partial valid channels and shared illumination constrain that position; equivalent adjacent models are averaged.
Ending a colour-search ray at a witnessed obstacle avoids vetoing a supported background or borrowing the foreground colour. Complete-region admission remains mandatory.
Joint illumination reduced noisy RGB error but regressed two X-Trans chromaticity patches. DR6 retains its compatible affine anchor; the shared model is used for unsupported discontinuities.
A one-sided CFA channel could make the preliminary step fit singular and block all paths. Its measured centre-side affine fit is retained; the final joint fit still validates all surviving sites.

The first validation invocation omitted --validation and repeated all 120 development cases exactly. It is excluded as independent evidence. The generator now requires an explicit mode, and the report asserts disjoint RAW and truth hashes for the corrected campaign.

The first distinct validation exposed four gradient regressions at CFA cell boundaries. A whole-window halo was rejected for perturbing established estimates. The final eight-pixel halo adjusts only an ambiguous outer line in a complete clipped component that contains a cell without any valid affine anchor. Source data are never replaced by reconstructed samples; affine-supported components remain intact.
The first release GUI root lacked the synthetic corpus. That attempt is retained privately; the complete smoke and surface checks passed after correcting the isolated test root.

The final timing hash check invalidated the assumption that all photographic outputs were unchanged. Two further D750 inputs reconstruct 26 and 139 saturated sites. No valid measurements change; both inputs pass additional two-slot XPC roundtrip/WB/export checks before installation. Their reduced SDR previews differ by at most one and two 8-bit codes respectively; this is not a physical accuracy measure.
limits: Compatibility matrices also generate the model data. CFA phases and related scenes are not independent physical-camera population samples. No calibrated acquisitions are available.

No general Bayer detail superiority is established: its unclipped demosaic is unchanged. Legacy still wins some noisy gradients, near-quantization neutral patches and isolated neutral highlights without eligible same-colour references; no overall superiority or old-engine removal is claimed.
Both-axis steps are supported; arbitrary curved/textured boundaries, wide regions beyond the support radius and contradictory colours can remain unchanged.
Complete clipping is non-identifiable without scene assumptions. A neutral aesthetic fallback would be a separate explicit policy, not colour recovery.

Six primary real/controlled inputs retain their previous raster. Two additional D750 timing inputs change in small supported saturated regions, without measured scene truth. Neither unchanged nor changed output establishes physical highlight accuracy.
Digital ceilings do not establish physical saturation thresholds. Measured sensor levels and calibrated targets remain necessary.
D40 is excluded at the owner request; point 6, D850/new format coverage, global R0-R4/SF gates and release security assurances are unchanged.
